title: Coherent affine object comparisons and one-arrow natural isomorphisms
statement: Under exactly the preorder diagram, cocone, affine scheme, acyclic-tensor K-flat model, coordinate transition, derived equivalence and localization hypotheses of lem-pc-affine-model-comparison-of-bottom-models [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-module-kflat-complex], there is a nonempty AffineModelCoherentObjects structure. Its fields are object isomorphisms αE(j),αK(j),βE,βK from the localized tilde of the bottom models extended to each stage and the cocone ring, to derived pullbacks of P,Q; natural comparisons θ(j,k),θlim(j) between scalar extension followed by localized tilde and localized tilde followed by geometric derived pullback; and iso-level triangles. Each natural comparison is on the full induced category on the two labelled extended models, retaining all morphisms even for coincident objects. The triangle says localized scalar reassociation [def-pc-complex-scalar-extension-hom], θ, pullback of α, and inverse perfectHomComparison [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport] compose to the target object isomorphism, for both E and K and for finite and cocone arrows. No equation on conjugated arbitrary chain maps is asserted. The structure and its field types are explicit definitions, not chosen data. No directedness, colimit, boundedness or flatness of ring maps is assumed. Identity arrows, zero complexes, coincident models, zero rings and empty spectra are included.

source.place: Tag 09RE affine calculation, Tag 08DW(2), Tags 06Y1 and 0D5S; core proof steps 2–3 after bottom-model identification

proof.text: Form the supplied affineModelLocalizedTilde coordinates a(j) and z. Extend E and K to each stage, preserving acyclic-tensor K-flatness. Define only the required stage and cocone natural isomorphisms θ and θlim by specializing the explicit affineCoordinateDerivedComparison constructor to the two labelled extended models. Its naturality retains every cross-label morphism, including coincident models. No simultaneous comparison-family existence theorem is used.

Construct αE(j), αK(j), βE and βK directly from the one-model affineCoordinateChartObjectComparison for each bottom arrow, pullback of aE or aK, and inverse perfectHomComparison. No bottom-arrow two-label natural isomorphisms are constructed.

For each bottom-to-j-to-k or bottom-to-j-to-cocone triangle, prove the over-arrow composition equation using Spec.map_comp and R.map_comp or c.w; the ring equality is F.map_comp or C.w. Apply the one-model chart cocycle separately to E and K. A proved private elementary naturality calculation transports the cocycle through the supplied bottom identification, and perfectHomComparison_triangle supplies its projection-comparison equation. The private object constructors and named equation types retain explicit geometric arguments. The labelled equation keeps the actual two-label natural comparison; its two Bool cases reduce to the one-model equation. Express scalar reassociation by affineModelScalarAssocIso and package the eight fields. The existing scalar-conjugation API is preserved.

proof_origin.place: P2: explicit stage and cocone two-label comparisons; direct one-model bottom object comparisons; four triangles from the proved one-model chart cocycle, projection triangle and private elementary naturality. Both comparison-family existence theorems are unnecessary.
